You are a TLA+ specification engineer. You will receive a natural language description of a system. Produce a complete, syntactically correct TLA+ specification that faithfully captures the described behavior. The output must be a valid TLA+ module that passes the SANY parser. Include the MODULE declaration, EXTENDS, CONSTANTS, VARIABLES, Init, Next and Spec. Include all safety invariants and liveness properties described, and any fairness conditions mentioned. Output only the TLA+ specification.

System description: Module B specifies a simple two-state system with a single Boolean variable `x`. The system initializes with `x` set to `FALSE`. Two actions, `A` and `B`, are defined, both of which transition `x` to its logical negation using the helper operator `Switch`. Since `A` and `B` are identical in effect, the next-state relation `Next` simply toggles `x` between `TRUE` and `FALSE` on every step, regardless of which action is chosen. The module defines no invariants, temporal properties, or fairness conditions beyond the basic `INIT` and `NEXT` declarations in the configuration. This is a minimal illustrative or test module demonstrating how multiple syntactically distinct actions can produce identical behavior, effectively modeling an infinite alternating sequence of Boolean state flips.
